name: onesource-docs-mcp

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search OneSource documentation by keyword. Returns the top 5 matching sections.

query.description: Search query — keywords to match against documentation sections

tools.name: get_query_reference
tools.description: Get full reference for a OneSource root GraphQL query — arguments, filters, return type. There are 12 root queries: address, addresses, block, blocks, contract, contracts, nft, nfts, token, tokens, transaction, transactions.

query_name.description: Name of a root GraphQL query (e.g. "token", "transactions", "block")

tools.name: get_type_definition
tools.description: Get the schema definition for a GraphQL type, enum, scalar, input, or interface. Returns fields, values, and descriptions.

type_name.description: Name of a GraphQL type, enum, scalar, input, or interface (e.g. "Token", "AddressFilter", "OrderDirection")

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: List or search working GraphQL examples. Without a topic, returns a summary of all available examples. With a topic, returns full example content matching that keyword.

tools.name: list_supported_chains
tools.description: List all blockchain networks supported by OneSource with endpoint URLs.

tools.name: get_filter_reference
tools.description: Get all filter fields and operators for a list query (e.g. transactions, tokens).

query_name.description: Name of a root GraphQL query (e.g. "transactions", "tokens", "nfts")

tools.name: get_pagination_guide
tools.description: Get the cursor-based pagination pattern with examples for a list query.

query_name.description: Name of a list query (e.g. "transactions", "tokens"). Defaults to "transactions" if omitted.

tools.name: get_schema_overview
tools.description: Get a high-level summary of the entire GraphQL schema — all queries, types, enums, and scalars.

tools.name: get_authentication_guide
tools.description: Get the authentication guide — API key format, endpoints, headers, and common mistakes.

tools.name: get_mcp_setup_guide
tools.description: Get the MCP installation and setup guide — quickstart, per-client instructions, x402 payments, configuration, and individual MCP packages. Use the topic parameter to focus on a specific area.

topic.description: Optional topic to focus on: "quickstart", "claude-desktop", "claude-code", "cursor", "vscode", "windsurf", "x402", "configuration", "individual-mcps", "tools". Without a topic, returns an overview of all available sections.
